craft_notes: Sthāyin: order-variety witnessed. Rows: seen then actors. Read aloud: variety show.

lines: And lo, those of knowledge, devotion, and the rest
are seen in their separate fire;
some embracing, some knowing the bliss;
l4.sanskrit_cite: kramaś ca vidyārāgādīnāṃ vicitro 'pi dṛṣṭaḥ kaścid rajyan vetti ko 'pi vidan rajyate ityādi
